subject.title: feat(android): add inline dictation to chat composer

question: Should Android retire the visible Voice destination and make Chat the sole user-facing entry point for realtime Talk and inline dictation?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes established navigation and folds two voice workflows into the Chat composer; source review can assess mechanics, but it cannot establish the intended long-term Android product model.

options.title: Confirm unified Chat as the voice surface
options.body: Accept Chat as the permanent destination for dictation and realtime Talk, retaining legacy Voice-route normalization while requiring complete device proof before merge.

options.title: Preserve a separate Voice destination
options.body: Keep the existing Voice navigation surface and narrow this PR to inline dictation or a non-breaking Talk entry point.

recommendation.title: Confirm unified Chat as the voice surface
recommendation.body: Accept Chat as the permanent destination for dictation and realtime Talk, retaining legacy Voice-route normalization while requiring complete device proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to this Android PR and authored the initial dictation implementation that introduces the microphone ownership boundary.
